name: Cheesy Tofu Asparagus Bake with Sun-Dried Tomatoes, Olives & Rice
instructions: Cut tofu into quarters along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; place in a large baking dish, arranging the spears in an even layer.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes and olives; add both to the bowl with the garlic, along with cream cheese, and mash with the back of a spoon to combine.
Season both sides of the tofu with spices, then arrange, in an even layer, on top of the asparagus; spread cream cheese mixture over top.
Finely grate Parmesan and sprinkle over the tofu.
Wash, dry, and juice lemons over the tofu, then drizzle with oil.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the tofu is warmed through and asparagus is tender, about 15 minutes.
When the tofu is done, change oven setting to broil on high; continue to cook until topping is golden, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide rice, asparagus, and tofu between plates; drizzle with sauce from the dish and enjoy!
author: Mealime
